text:
Samir Patel: Heads-up — after the canary cutover to ingress-v2 in us-east-1 I can't see the p95/p99 lines on the latency dashboard (p50/p90 still present).

deploy-bot: Canary deploy finished: services/edge-proxy v2.13.0 -> v2.14.0 (canary) at 2025-02-08T15:01:40Z

Jamie Cho: which dashboard and panel? screenshot? is this across all envs or only prod/us-east?

Samir Patel: dashboard: https://console.redwood.dev/d/latency/requests (panel: latency by route). screenshot: https://imgur.com/a/mock123 (shows flat grey area where p95/p99 should be). only prod/us-east so far.

Lina Gomez: getting a couple of customer complaints about missing tail visibility — they're worried about SLA regressions. Can we triage asap?

Samir Patel: quick check: p50/p90 series exist, but p95/p99 series count is 0 series on the panel. the panel query is: `quantile_over_time(0.95, rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))` — note bucket name is unchanged.

Priya Rao: could be label relabeling during the cutover. In the new sidecar we changed `service` -> `svc_name` for a subset of metrics and the dashboard panels still assume `service`. If the panel uses a grouped-by label that no longer exists it might collapse the series.

Samir Patel: checking raw prometheus: `count by(le) (redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{env="prod",service=~"edge.*"})` returns 0, but `count by(le) (redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{env="prod",svc_name=~"edge.*"})` returns expected series. so labels shifted during canary.

monitor-bot: Alert: metrics-relabeller on metrics-host-3 restarted at 2025-02-08T15:05:12Z (rolling restart during deploy).

Priya Rao: yep — relabeller rule introduced `svc_name` and removed `service` for normalized labels. we planned to roll dashboards but missed a templated query. immediate fix options: 1) revert relabeller rollout to restore `service` label, 2) update dashboard queries to use `label_replace` or fallback to either label.

Samir Patel: applied hotfix to the panel query (temporary): `label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.95, rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])), "service", "$1", "svc_name", "(.*)")` — panel shows p95/p99 back within ~90s. pushing a follow-up PR to make dashboards tolerant.

Lina Gomez: thanks — can you add the customer-facing note? they asked for ETA.

Samir Patel: replied to customers, said tails restored and we're doing a config update to dashboards + a small docs blurb about relabelling impact. next steps: rollout dashboard changes, coordinate with infra to document label migrations. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/pull/4821

Jamie Cho: leave this thread pinned until dashboards in all regions are updated. good find. :thumbsup:
